settings.hero_subcopy: Pens, ink and the tools that fill a page — refillable, considered, made to be kept and used, not thrown away.
settings.story_text: A small set of writing tools chosen to last — refillable pens, proper ink, and pieces that feel right in the hand.
settings.standard_lead: We don’t sell disposables. A few writing tools chosen to be refilled for life — how they’re made matters as much as how they write.
settings.proof1_body: Pens built to be topped up, not binned. Ink by the bottle, not the cartridge.
settings.proof2_body: UK and European makers with real craft heritage — named workshops, not anonymous factories.
settings.proof3_body: Brass, wood and proper nibs that age with use and last for years.
settings.proof4_body: Refill instead of replace — the most sustainable pen is the one you already own.
settings.companion_kicker: The other half of the desk
settings.companion_lead: A good pen wants a good page. Start with a notebook worth filling.
